title: Microsoft Teams: admin recommendations to enable agents and apps for applications already in use
summary: The roadmap and Message Center descriptions, optional default and rollout window are supported. The PowerShell cell needs correction: it combines alternatives into one command line that grants access to Everyone before attempting an incomplete second command. The org-wide toggle also needs its documented per-app exceptions stated.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The printed PowerShell line provides working alternatives for assigning Everyone or selected users and groups.
claims.quote: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone
claims.fix: Replace the single code string containing '; or' with two separately labelled, complete alternatives: 'Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app ID> -AppAssignmentType Everyone' and 'Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app ID> -AppAssignmentType UsersAndGroups -OperationType Add -Users <users> -Groups <groups>'. Keep the word 'or' outside executable code and tell readers to run only the intended alternative. The current line first sets Everyone and then starts a statement named 'or', not Update-M365TeamsApp, so it cannot perform the selected-users alternative as printed. Microsoft documents that semicolons delimit PowerShell statements at https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/terminal/command-line-arguments#command-line-argument-examples; the cmdlet reference documents both assignment types and the named parameters.
